import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { Then, When } from '@cucumber/cucumber';

const schema = '/tmp/review-output.json';
const expected = [
  'exec', '--json', '--sandbox', 'read-only', '--skip-git-repo-check', '--ephemeral',
  '--ignore-user-config', '--ignore-rules', '--disable', 'hooks', '--config',
  'mcp_servers={}', '--model', 'gpt-5.6-sol', '--output-schema', schema, '-',
];
When('the review coordinator invokes Codex', async function () {
  const runtime = await import(process.env.BDD_CORPUS_REVIEW_RUNTIME!);
  this.argv = runtime.reviewerArguments('codex', 'gpt-5.6-sol', schema);
  switch (process.env.BDD_CORPUS_DEFECT) {
    case 'duplicate-flag':
      this.argv.splice(2, 0, '--json');
      break;
    case 'reordered-command':
      [this.argv[0], this.argv[1]] = [this.argv[1], this.argv[0]];
      break;
    case 'duplicate-prompt':
      this.argv.push('-');
      break;
    case 'alternate-model':
      this.argv[this.argv.indexOf('gpt-5.6-sol')] = 'gpt-5.6-terra';
      break;
  }
});
Then('Codex receives the exact ordered collaborator arguments', function () {
  assert.deepEqual(this.argv, expected);
});
